caption: A can of orange soda, perched on a minimalist white shelf, begins to wobble slightly. As it tips over, it falls with a soft thud onto the shelf, the top of the can colliding with the side of the book standing beside it. The books remain undisturbed, their spines facing outward, adding a touch of intellectual charm to the scene.
